title: Work out a formula
summary: COBOL: Work out a formula. Multiply 2 by 4.
introduction: COMPUTE assigns the result of a calculation. Read the example, then check the result.
learningObjectives: Work out a formula with COBOL

blocks.text: Install GnuCOBOL. Save each example as lesson.cob, run cobc -x -free lesson.cob -o lesson, then run the program.
